description:
If an insurant could be possibly subrogated against, I get information about that. 
I check that case and if the possibility is really there, I send a request for payment to the insurant and make me a reminder. 
If recourse is not possible, I close the case. 
When we receive the money, I make a booking and close the case. 
If the insurant disagrees with the recourse, I'll have to check the reasoning of that. 
If he is right, I simply close the case. 
If he is wrong, I forward the case to a collection agency. It the deadline for disagreement is reached and we haven't received any money, I forward the case to the collection agency as well.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Recourse"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/recourse">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Request for payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Disagreement" name="Disagreement with recourse"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Recourse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurer" name="Insurer" processRef="Process_Recourse"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Insurant" name="Insurant" processRef="Process_Insurant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentRequest"
                      name="Request for payment"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest"
                      targetRef="Start_RequestReceived"
                      messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Payment"
                      name="Payment"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendPayment"
                      targetRef="Event_PaymentReceived"
                      messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Disagreement"
                      name="Disagreement with recourse"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendDisagreement"
                      targetRef="Event_DisagreementReceived"
                      messageRef="Message_Disagreement"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Recourse" name="Handle possible recourse" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_InformationReceived" name="Information about possible subrogation received"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check case"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible" name="Is recourse possible?" default="Flow_RecourseNotPossible"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send request for payment" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeReminder" name="Make reminder"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" name="Wait for payment, disagreement, or deadline" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Payment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisagreementReceived" name="Disagreement received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Disagreement" messageRef="Message_Disagreement"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisagreementDeadline" name="Disagreement deadline reached with no money received">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BookPayment" name="Make booking"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check reasoning"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsurantRight" name="Is the insurant right?" default="Flow_InsurantWrong"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeClose" name="Continue to close case"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseCase" name="Close case"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CaseClosed" name="Case closed"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeForward" name="Continue to collection agency"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ForwardCase" name="Forward case to collection agency"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CaseForwarded" name="Case forwarded to collection agency"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Check" sourceRef="Start_InformationReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Recourse" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecoursePossible" name="Recourse is possible" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">recoursePossible = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecourseNotPossible" name="Recourse is not possible" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Gateway_MergeClose"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Reminder" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Wait" sourceRef="Task_MakeReminder" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Payment" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Disagreement" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DisagreementReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Deadline" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Booking" sourceRef="Event_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_BookPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Booking_CloseMerge" sourceRef="Task_BookPayment" targetRef="Gateway_MergeClose"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disagreement_Check" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_InsurantRight" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_InsurantRight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurantRight" name="Insurant is right" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurantRight" targetRef="Gateway_MergeClose">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insurantIsRight = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurantWrong" name="Insurant is wrong" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurantRight" targetRef="Gateway_MergeForward"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deadline_ForwardMerge" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementDeadline" targetRef="Gateway_MergeForward"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForwardMerge_Task" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeForward" targetRef="Task_ForwardCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Forward_End" sourceRef="Task_ForwardCase" targetRef="End_CaseForwarded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CloseMerge_Task" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeClose" targetRef="Task_CloseCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Close_End" sourceRef="Task_CloseCase" targetRef="End_CaseClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Insurant" name="Respond to payment request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RequestReceived" name="Payment request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PaymentRequest" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsurantResponse" name="How does the insurant respond?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPayment" name="Send payment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDisagreement" name="Send disagreement with recourse" messageRef="Message_Disagreement"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaymentSent" name="Payment sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DisagreementSent" name="Disagreement sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Response" sourceRef="Start_RequestReceived" targetRef="Gateway_InsurantResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Response_Payment" name="Payment" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurantResponse" targetRef="Task_SendPayment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">response = payment</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Response_Disagreement" name="Disagreement" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurantResponse" targetRef="Task_SendDisagreement">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">response = disagreement</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_End" sourceRef="Task_SendPayment" targetRef="End_PaymentSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disagreement_End" sourceRef="Task_SendDisagreement" targetRef="End_DisagreementSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
